name: tdd-guardian-for-codex
description: Codex-native TDD Guardian with test-lane, coverage, mutation, commit, push, and end-of-turn quality gates.

interface.shortDescription: Strict TDD workflows and automated quality gates.
interface.longDescription: Plan, design, implement, audit, and review changes under strict test-driven development, with deterministic Codex hooks for turn, commit, and push gates.
defaultPrompt: Use $tdd-guardian to initialize TDD gates in this repository.
Use $tdd-guardian to run the commit gate and report failures.
Use $tdd-guardian to implement this change with red-green-refactor.
